listing.name: 2Xtreme — 2Xtreme-recomp (catsandsoup)
listing.summary: This early preview has project-reported disc preparation, intro and keyboard pause-menu support. Controller testing, full-speed play, settings, widescreen, original Options bindings, rumble, player 2, save states and notarization remain unfinished. Full playthroughs are unconfirmed. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SCUS-94508 CUE/BIN disc image. The app copies it into its private ApplicationSupport/2Xtreme/disc folder and generates native game code locally on first launch. MIT-licensed OpenBIOS is included; no retail BIOS is required.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract the project’s early-preview 2Xtreme.zip and open 2Xtreme.app to import your own USA CUE/BIN. The project says the first launch builds the game locally in about 15 seconds. The app is not notarized. The player package needs no Xcode, Homebrew or Python; building from source with make_app.sh additionally needs Apple tools, Homebrew and the pinned Zig version. Portcove has not inspected the downloaded package.

warnings: This early preview has project-reported disc preparation, intro and keyboard pause-menu support. Controller testing, full-speed play, settings, widescreen, original Options bindings, rumble, player 2, save states and notarization remain unfinished. Full playthroughs are unconfirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
